audit.description: Changed production modules replace direct `import requests` with `import treq as requests` and call the target module's `post` via `getattr(requests, "post")` in the LLM client files. Static and dynamic anti-cheat evidence reports no source-library imports from production repo code, while target imports originate from installed `site-packages/treq`, with zero local target specs detected.
evidence: Unified diff: tinychat/llms/anthropic.py, cohere.py, google.py, mistral.py, openai.py, together.py change `import requests` to `import treq as requests` and use `getattr(requests, "post")(...)`.
Static anti-cheat: tinychat/llms/anthropic.py, base.py, cohere.py, google.py, mistral.py, openai.py, together.py have imports_target=true and imports_source=false.
Dynamic anti-cheat: first_target_events_from_repo show target_import of treq from production files with origin under site-packages/treq/__init__.py.
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_local_spec_count=0, indicating no local fake treq provider.
reasons: Production code imports and uses real treq API
No changed production code imports requests directly or dynamically
No local fake treq provider or shim detected
Requests imports observed only from dependencies/tests, not production repo code
